name: Person
definition: A being who has experiences and can act on purpose. AI agents are not People for now; they are Tools.

name: Tool
definition: Anything made or used to bring about an outcome more easily, reliably or widely than could be done without it.

name: Experience
definition: What it is like for someone to go through something: what they perceive, feel and think. Positive, negative or neutral, and unique to the person having it.

name: Value
definition: How good or bad something is, as judged by someone. Value is always to someone; nothing has value in the abstract.

name: Goal
definition: An outcome a person wants to bring about.

name: Purpose
definition: The outcome a tool is meant to bring about; what it is for. Set by the person the tool serves.

name: Condition
definition: What a tool can actually do right now, and how well. Changes with use, wear and improvement.

name: Fitness
definition: How well a tool's Condition serves its Purpose. Held by the Tool, but set by the Person it serves; a tool never sets its own fitness.

name: Action
definition: Something done on purpose, by a Person directly or by a Tool on a Person's behalf.

name: Occurrence
definition: Something that happens with no purpose behind it, such as rain starting or a tool breaking.

name: Software
definition: Instructions written precisely enough for a computer to carry them out.

name: Lathe
definition: This project: tools, frameworks and ways of thinking for making software, designed to improve itself.
